---
name: Constitutional or evidence review
about: Report a specific constitutional concern, source correction, or research limitation.
title: ""
---

## Commit and affected record
Identify the commit, file, provision, decision, or source identifier.

## Claim or problem
Separate observation, interpretation, and proposed change. Include the exact
scope; disagreement is welcome without claiming certainty beyond the evidence.

## Evidence and alternatives
Link primary sources or reproducible examples. Identify contrary evidence,
uncertainty, material dissent, conflicts, and plausible alternative explanations.

## Constitutional and practical implications
Explain authority, beneficiary, membership, review, change-category, and
implementation implications where relevant. A proposal is not a human decision.

## Suggested next step
State the review or correction sought and what evidence would resolve the issue.
Do not include personal data, secrets, unpublished proprietary material, or
sensitive exploit details; use the repository security policy for sensitive reports.
